title: Stirred to Give
description: In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner shares a stunning example of how the hearts of our youth can be stirred to give to the kingdom, just like the people of Israel in Exodus 36. As Pastor Chris recounts an incredible story of soul-winning and generosity, he reveals how God is calling us to give to His house with a willingness to obey and trust in His provision. Join Pastor Chris as he unpacks the Bible's call to generosity and inspires you to live out your faith in a way that brings glory to God.
